subject.title: feat: add bounded PR detail fill command

question: Should Gitcrawl adopt `fill-pr-details` and its strict per-invocation quota-reserve behavior as a supported operator-facing CLI contract?
rationale: The implementation now appears mechanically sound, but it adds a substantial command and quota policy surface, and the canonical issue still explicitly awaits product direction.

options.title: Accept the bounded command
options.body: Sponsor the command and strict reserve contract, then merge after latest-head real GitHub behavior proof is posted.

options.title: Narrow the first version
options.body: Land bounded missing-detail selection and progress while deferring or simplifying the reserve contract.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Keep targeted `sync --numbers --with pr-details` as the supported workflow and close the feature issue and PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded command
recommendation.body: Sponsor the command and strict reserve contract, then merge after latest-head real GitHub behavior proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-backed owner of both existing behaviors being composed into this new command contract.
